lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission session on October 8, where the commission holds a joint work session with the BOCC on an Affordable Housing Code Update — a policy push that directly shapes who can live here long-term. Also Thursday, SMART's board takes up a resolution amending the Gondola Project IGA and opens FY27 budget talks covering $5.2M in annual tax revenue. On the community side, Oktoberfest kicks off Friday and the Telluride Horror Show is right around the corner.

notable.stake: County and BOCC jointly updating affordable housing code — policy with real local impact.
SMART votes on Gondola IGA amendment and sets course for $5.2M FY27 budget.
